$comment: Metered CI. A full `gh run rerun` re-bills green jobs: only `--failed` or `--job` reruns pass, after reading the failure. A manual workflow run bills the full suite, so it asks. The REST roads to both are the guard's code (evaluateGhApi).

deny.reason: Rerun only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun <id> --failed`, after reading the failure.

ask.reason: A manual workflow run bills the full suite; say what it is for.
